summary: Frontend-only UI verification of Clara Campaigns layout finalization. All visual acceptance criteria PASS: login shows centered white rounded card over KOODH bear cosmic pattern background with chevron + divider + 'Clara' wordmark at top (exactly ONE chevron, no double); 'Welcome back' heading + email+password inputs + periwinkle (#7380b6) Sign in button + Forgot password link all present. Admin login with admkoodh@koodh.com succeeded, Welcome dialog with 'Enter Clara' button clears. Dashboard header background = rgb(245,246,248) = #F5F6F8 (matches canvas, no white band, no border-b). Logo lockup = chevron (/clara-chevron.png) + divider + 'Clara' wordmark on left. User menu is compact: only rose-gradient avatar circle (bg-gradient-to-br from-rose-500 to-rose-700, letter 'Y') + chevron, with Help (?) icon + vertical divider BEFORE avatar. User menu dropdown: bg: rgb(255,255,255) solid white, backdrop-filter: none, classes include 'bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-lg rounded-2xl', border-radius 16px. Sign out color rgb(225,29,72) = text-rose-600. TopLoader bar observed as thin BLUE strip at top of page during navigation. /network page also loads with same header (confirmed logo-pill + chevron + Clara wordmark + Production chip + help icon + rose Y avatar in screenshots). No React compile errors; only 2 non-blocking Radix a11y warnings about DialogTitle on the Welcome setup modal.

issues: Radix a11y warnings in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Non-blocking but should wrap title in VisuallyHidden for screen reader support.

action_items: (Optional) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle + Description to the post-login Welcome/Setup DialogContent to silence Radix a11y console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Post-login Welcome dialog blocks the viewport for several seconds without a visible close affordance until the sequence completes; could trap users if a step fails. Consider adding a Skip/Close button and fallback timeout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Clara Campaigns layout criteria confirmed on preview (login card over KOODH bear bg, single chevron, periwinkle Sign in, dashboard header bg #F5F6F8, chevron+Clara logo lockup, compact user menu with help icon + divider + rose avatar + chevron, dropdowns solid white rounded-2xl with shadow-lg, sign out rose-600, TopLoader bar bg-blue-500). Only outstanding items are Radix a11y DialogTitle warnings on Welcome setup modal.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; implementation matches request.
